fields.title: Listing / seller record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Poshmark's own Vuex state shape. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). "browse"/"listing" mode records carry the full upstream listing object verbatim (title, price, brand, condition, size, pictures, creator_username, aggregates, ...). "seller" mode records carry the full upstream closet-user object verbatim (username, profile_v2, aggregates with followers/posts/items-sold/ratings, ...).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The brand:value / listing ID / username that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. listing_not_found, seller_not_found).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_gridTotal.title: Grid total
_gridTotal.description: browse mode -- Poshmark's own reported total match count for this brand/category (capped around 5000).

description.title: Description
description.description: browse/listing mode -- full listing description text.

pictures.title: Pictures
pictures.description: browse/listing mode -- full list of photo objects.

lister.title: Lister profile
lister.description: listing mode only -- the seller's basic profile object, embedded on the listing detail page.

aggregates.title: Aggregates
aggregates.description: seller mode -- followers, following, posts, items sold, 5-star rating counts, share/like/comment totals.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across browse / listing / seller records.
